SELECT HD.DEPTNO, HDN.CONTENT, HD.PARENT_DEPT_NO, '1' AS ISCHECKED FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HD,HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HDN WHERE HD.DEPTNO = 'LOTTE00110000' AND HDN.LANGUAGE(+)=#interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND HD.DEPTNO=HDN.DEPTNO(+)
SELECT * FROM SY_USER_DEPT SD WHERE SD.USER_NO = #USERNO:NUMERIC# AND SD.DEPTNO= #DEPTNO:VARCHAR#

SELECT HD.DEPTNO, HDN.CONTENT, HD.PARENT_DEPT_NO, HD.DEPT_LEVEL, (CASE WHEN SD.DEPTNO IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ISCHECKED, (CASE WHEN HD.DEPT_LEVEL > 2 THEN 'false' ELSE 'true' END) AS ISEXPAND, RN FROM (SELECT T.*, ROWNUM RN FROM HR_DEPARTMENT T /* WHERE T.DEPT_LEVEL < 4 */ START WITH T.PARENT_DEPT_NO = '0' CONNECT BY PRIOR T.DEPTNO = T.PARENT_DEPT_NO ORDER SIBLINGS BY T.ORDERNO, T.DEPT_LEVEL DESC, T.DEPTID) HD, SY_USER_DEPT SD, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HDN WHERE HD.DEPTNO = SD.DEPTNO(+) AND HDN.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND HD.DEPTNO = HDN.DEPTNO(+) AND HD.CPNY_ID=#interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND (HD.DATE_CREATED < SYSDATE AND HD.DATE_ENDED > SYSDATE OR HD.DATE_ENDED IS NULL)
SD.ADMIN_NO(+) = #ADMINNO:NUMERIC#
SD.USER_NO(+) = #USERNO:NUMERIC#
SD.DEPTNO(+) = #DEPTNO:VARCHAR#
SD.ADMIN_NO(+) = (SELECT ADMINNO FROM SY_ADMIN SA WHERE SA.ADMINID = #EMPID:VARCHAR#)
ORDER BY RN
